totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.help: A code of an app such as FreeOTP, Aegis, Google or Microsoft Authenticator.
totp.step1: Open your authenticator app and add an account.
totp.step2: Scan the link or enter this key:
totp.step3: Enter the code the app shows.
totp.remove_confirm: Remove the authenticator app? Its codes no longer work.
totp.code_help: 6 digits; a new code every 30 seconds.
